messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
And I am determined to keep my head up and have a good week!

output.original_text: And I am determined to keep my head up and have a good week!
output.joy: And I am absolutely thrilled to keep my head up and have an amazing week!
output.sadness: And I am trying to keep my head up and hope to have a decent week, despite everything.
output.fear: And I am trying to keep my head up, but I can't shake the feeling that this week will be tough.
output.anger: And I am determined to keep my head up, no matter how unfair this week seems!
output.surprise: And I am determined to keep my head up and have a surprisingly good week ahead!
output.disgust: And I am determined to keep my head up, even though the prospect of this week is just so unappealing!
